note: Ground-truth evaluation settings for robot_vision/gt_path.py (evaluation code only; never read by inference code). Declared 2026-10-23 before any v4 run.
optimal_length_note: Python's A* length must equal Unity's optimal_path.json length within this absolute tolerance (same grid, same step costs, so only float rounding is allowed).
near_optimal_note: A trail point counts as near the optimal path when it is within this many grid cells (cell_size_m each) of the nearest cell centre of the optimal CORRIDOR, i.e. of any shortest path (docs/project_flow_v4.md: share of the trail within one grid cell; corridor rule decided 2026-10-29).
leak_note: Leak test: ground-truth layer on and off must render identical images (0 = every pixel equal, so the images must be lossless, e.g. PNG).
unity_leak_note: Unity records its own leak-test result in session.json (decided 2026-10-29) and keeps the image pairs in leak_test/ (it never writes leak_test.json, which is Python's independent check). CONFIRMED 2026-11-04 by Nusrat (commit 43cbeb2, TrialRunnerV4): the result is the nested object 'leak_test' in session.json and its boolean 'passed', so unity_leak_result_key is the dotted path 'leak_test.passed'. Only the boolean true passes; false, a missing key, or any other value (for example the string 'true') is not passed. While unity_leak_result_key_confirmed is false gt_path.session_leak_check reports 'not passed' and a final evaluation is refused. This file is in the frozen set.
